info.title: Consent Services APIs
info.description: APIs for managing beneficiary consent through OTP or Biomentrics verification.

tags.name: Authorizations
tags.description: Endpoints for creating and retrieving patient consent authorizations via OTP or biometrics.

tags.name: Send OTP
tags.description: Endpoints for sending OTP to beneficiaries.

tags.name: OTP Whitelist
tags.description: Endpoints for managing OTP whitelist requests for beneficiaries.

post.description: Creates a new authorization by capturing patient consent via OTP or biometrics. Use the OTP strategy for standard outpatient and inpatient consent; use the biometrics strategy (eKYC or fingerprint) when the facility has a registered hardware agent. The same endpoint is used across claims creation and consent workflows.
post.summary: Create a new authorization (OTP or biometrics)

requestBody.description: Authorization request payload. Choose one strategy: OTP (phone-based one-time password) or Biometrics (eKYC/fingerprint via hardware agent).

oneOf.title: OTP Authorization
oneOf.description: Authorization request using a one-time password (OTP) sent to the patient's registered phone number. Use this strategy for outpatient or inpatient consent where OTP verification is available.

otp.description: One-time password delivered to the patient's registered phone number.

interventions.description: List of intervention codes for the services being requested in this visit.

oneOf.title: Biometrics Authorization
oneOf.description: Authorization request using biometric verification via a registered hardware agent. Supports eKYC (SHA flow) and fingerprint (Under-18 patient flow). All fields are required for biometric consent.

agent_id.description: ID number of the registered biometrics agent. Obtained from the user logged into the hardware server application.

authorizing_device_os.description: Operating system of the device making the biometrics request.

ekyc_provider_id.description: Name of the healthcare facility initiating the eKYC verification.

factors.description: Biometric verification flow(s) to use. `SHA` triggers the eKYC flow; `fingerprint` is used for Under-18 patient consent.

interventions.description: List of intervention codes for the services being requested in this visit.

is_biometrics_discharge_authorization.description: Set to `true` only when this authorization is for a patient's discharge. `false` for all other consent scenarios.

is_emergency.description: Set to `true` if this authorization is for an emergency claim.

is_integration.description: Indicates an integration with external systems. Always `true` for system-to-system integrations.

provider.description: The healthcare facility's Facility Registry (FR) code.

work_station_id.description: Workstation identifier obtained from the hardware server application running in the background on the authorizing device.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields

schema.description: Standard error response format for all error conditions.

error.description:
@Description	HTTP status text from the standard HTTP status codes
	@Example		"Bad Request"

message.description:
@Description	Detailed error message explaining what went wrong
	@Example		"token missing required tenant_id claim"

500.description: Internal Server Error - Service error occurred

post.description: Sends a One-Time Password (OTP) to a beneficiary’s registered contact. Used for verifying patient identity and obtaining consent before proceeding with certain operations like claim creation.

schema.description: Request payload for sending OTP to patient. All fields are required and validated.

contact_id.description: Identifier of the contact (phone number record) to which the OTP should be sent.

intervention_codes.description: Intervention code(s) for the service scheduled to be offered

patient_id.description: Client registry identifier of the beneficiary associated with the patient

schema.description: Standard success response format for all successful operations.

data.description:
@Description	Response data payload containing operation details
	@Example		{"status": "success"}

message.description:
@Description	Success message describing the operation result
	@Example		"Visit has been successfully started"

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

500.description: Internal Server Error - Service error occurred

post.description: Creates an OTP whitelist request for a beneficiary to allow using OTP for consent request under special conditions (e.g., power outage, amputee). This includes supporting attachments as proof for the whitelist reason.

attachments.description: List of attachment metadata. Each attachment specifies the title, document type, and associated file field for upload.

document_title.description: Title or description of the attachment.

file_field_name.description: Field name for uploading the corresponding file in multipart form data.

file_name.description: Name of the file to be uploaded.

beneficiary_cr_id.description: Unique identifier of the beneficiary within the coverage system.

biometric_attempts.description: Number of failed attempts using biometrics.

facility_fr_code.description: Facility registry (FR) code identifying the facility raising the whitelist request.

facility_fr_type.description: Type of facility registry identifier (e.g. KMFL code) accompanying the facility_fr_code.

reason.description: Detailed explanation of the reason for the whitelist request.

reason_type.description: Type of reason for requesting the whitelist.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing required fields or invalid request

500.description: Internal Server Error - Service error occurred

get.description: Retrieve OTP whitelist requests using a GUID or by combining `beneficiary_cr_id`, `facility_id`, and `facility_id_type`.

parameters.description: Unique GUID of the OTP whitelist request.
parameters.name: guid

400.description: Bad Request - Missing query parameters or invalid request input
